title: Completeness statement
description: What one collection run can honestly say about each listing surface it read, recorded on the run's lifecycle Batch under metadata.completeness (req-grid-reconcile-evidence, spec-grid-reconcile.md). 'Complete' was carrying six distinct claims; this records them separately, per surface, with a reason wherever a claim is negative or unknown, so that a later reconcile pass can decide whether an absence from this surface licenses anything. Two fields are DERIVED by tap_grid.completeness.record_completeness and refused if authored: applied (from the referenced write batches' committed status) and reconcilable (from the other attributes). Nothing here is a verdict and nothing here retires anything.

recorded_at.description: When the statement was recorded on the batch (UTC, ISO 8601). Set by the recorder, not the producer.

surfaces.description: One statement per listing surface the run touched. Order is the order the producer recorded them; it carries no meaning.

relation.description: Which relation of the subject was listed, in the source's own terms (e.g. 'repository.workflows', 'organization.members'). Names the surface together with subject and filter.

filter.description: The source-side filter the listing depended on, verbatim, or null when the listing was unfiltered. A filtered surface must also record filter_control (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-4).

subject.description: The parent whose relation was listed — the source locator or the grid entity id of the parent — so the statement is about a particular thing, not a run.

interval.description: The observation interval: between which two instants the surface was read (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-5).

first.description: Timestamp of the first request that read this surface (UTC, ISO 8601).

last.description: Timestamp of the last request that read this surface (UTC, ISO 8601).

scope_authorized.description: This credential was permitted to ask for this surface: the run's scope statement crossed with the source's declared permission. null means not determinable; both false and null require a reason.

enumeration_complete.description: The walk reached the end of the chain and was not capped — the client's own verdict. Forced to false by the recorder when the surface is filtered and its control is absent or failed. null means not determinable; both false and null require a reason.

source_consistent.description: The rows came from one coherent source snapshot. true ONLY where the source promises it and source_promise names the promise; the recorder refuses true without one and never derives it from enumeration_complete or a matching count (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-2). 'unknown' is the honest value for most sources and requires a reason.

source_promise.description: The source's own snapshot guarantee that licenses source_consistent: true (e.g. 'Kubernetes list resourceVersion'). Required when source_consistent is true; otherwise null.

filter_control.description: The positive control on a source-side filter: a deliberately bogus filter value was sent and the result compared (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-4). null when the surface has no filter.

value_changed.description: true when the bogus value changed the result, proving the filter is honoured; false means the filter is being ignored and an empty answer is worthless.

count_observed.description: How many rows the walk returned, when counted. Compared with count_reported as a rejection control only (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-3); never proof of consistency.

count_reported.description: The total the parent reported for this relation, when the source offers one. A mismatch with count_observed makes the surface not reconcilable.

admitted.description: The gather passed its completeness gate and reached processing. Stops short of persistence: admitted is never applied (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-6).

applied_batches.description: The write batches whose commit carried this surface's observations. applied is DERIVED from their status by the recorder: every one must be closed (committed); a failed, open or missing batch makes the surface not applied.

reasons.description: Why an attribute is negative or unknown, keyed by attribute name (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-1); the recorder adds its own entries for the values it forces or derives. An attribute that is not true and has no reason is refused.

additionalProperties.description: A short reason, code first, prose after (e.g. 'count_mismatch: observed 41, reported 42').

applied.description: DERIVED: the observations from this surface were committed — every batch in applied_batches is closed. An unchanged re-observation still counts (req-grid-reconcile-evidence-7). Authoring this field is refused.

reconcilable.description: DERIVED: scope_authorized, enumeration_complete, admitted and applied are all true and the counts do not disagree. source_consistent may be 'unknown' — the type's absence policy names what substitutes. Authoring this field is refused.
